Synthetic existing-data lookup retry, 2026-11-09, in a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org from a campaign Dev Hub. Each of the 186 still-unpaired targets was independently queried under SeeAllData=true at source APIs 62.0 and 67.0, using only records present in this freshly created scratch org. The probe requires one child with a null lookup and two children with distinct non-null parent IDs before attempting five orderings. All 372 probes reported setup or query skips: none supplied a complete ordering. LIMIT 100 bounds the non-null scan, so these skips do not prove all data shapes impossible. Error text was scrubbed of record IDs, email addresses and URLs. The org was deleted and its unique description matched exactly one Dev Hub ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted.
